The following events took place in '''157 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Births==
*[[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]

==Behind the scenes==
The sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]'' states that the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]] is 157 years old. ''Galaxy Guide 7'' describes the current state of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] as it exists circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Although this year is not stated outright in the source material, simple mathematics arrives at a birth date of 157 BBY for Chalmun.
